people.text: Maiko loves dancing and wants to learn new dance styles quickly. She'd like to meet successful dancers and also take part in competitions.
Marta and her younger sister would like to join an acting group at the weekend. They haven't done anything like this before, so their mum wants to go with them at first.
Eliana's quite nervous so would like the possibility of some drama training on her own at first. She's free during the week and hopes to act in a play one day.
Henry is an experienced dancer who enjoys entering competitions. He wants to concentrate on jazz dance and improve his drama skills too.
Jose wants to perform in plays, and is interested in joining an acting course run by professionals with a diploma at the end.

items.label: A
items.title: Let's go!
items.text: We offer classes for advanced dance and drama students who want to develop their talents to a really high level. Our expert teachers will work with you on your acting and your preferred dance style so that you are ready to compete against the best!

items.label: B
items.title: Mouse House
items.text: We welcome all levels of ability and experience, and offer drama classes for children of all ages, led by professional performers. The activities are fun and great for building self-confidence, so you're soon ready to enter competitions. We meet every Saturday and parents are welcome to wait in the hall.

items.label: C
items.title: The Phoenix Group
items.text: With us, you'll take part in weekend drama workshops and receive a free ticket per term to watch a play at the local theatre. You'll have opportunities to perform to the public throughout the year. No experience is necessary, but you will need to book a term in advance.

items.label: D
items.title: Monsters DC
items.text: This group is for young people under 16 who want to develop their acting ability, or for more experienced actors who want to teach others their skills. All members are encouraged to take part in our annual show, and every month you can meet successful actors and get their advice on a career in acting.

items.label: E
items.title: Peppermint Performers
items.text: Working with experienced theatre directors, you'll learn performance skills through a long programme of workshops. The first term is a series of skill-based sessions covering a range of different performance styles, with certificates for successful students. In future terms, you'll take part in plays performed for the general public.

items.label: F
items.title: Moon Productions
items.text: In our classes, we teach jazz, tap and street dance, and you'll soon be creating your own dances. We hold contests against other clubs and put on displays for parents every summer. Want to find out what a life as a professional dancer is like? Every term we invite a star to talk about their career.

items.label: G
items.title: The Focus Group
items.text: Classes are available every evening. You'll receive excellent training in dance and drama, and develop techniques and performance skills in no time. One-to-one tuition is offered, and it's possible to work towards a certificate. You'll also have the opportunity to take part in a professional play.

items.label: H
items.title: Bubble Company
items.text: Just come along with your friends and we'll do the rest. There's no need to have any experience, and we provide all the costumes and special dance shoes if you need them. We run small hour-long classes in dance or drama every evening after school, and family members are welcome to stay and watch.

explanations.6: Maiko 喜欢跳舞，想快速学新舞种，结识成功舞者，参加比赛。F 选项 “Moon Productions” 教爵士、踢踏和街舞，举办与其他俱乐部的比赛，每学期邀请明星谈职业，符合需求。原文 “teach jazz, tap and street dance... hold contests against other clubs... invite a star to talk about their career” 对应 “new dance styles, meet successful dancers, competitions”。
explanations.7: Marta 和妹妹想周末加入表演团体，没经验，妈妈想先一起去。B 选项 “Mouse House” 欢迎各水平，有专业演员带领的儿童戏剧课，每周六上课，家长可在大厅等待，符合需求。原文 “welcome all levels... drama classes for children... meet every Saturday and parents are welcome to wait” 对应 “acting group, no experience, mum goes with them”。
explanations.8: Eliana 紧张，想先单独上戏剧培训，周中有空，希望有一天参演戏剧。G 选项 “The Focus Group” 每晚有课，提供一对一指导，可考取证书，有机会参加专业戏剧，符合需求。原文 “classes available every evening... one-to-one tuition... work towards a certificate... take part in a professional play” 对应 “nervous, training on own, act in a play”。
explanations.9: Henry 是有经验的舞者，喜欢参加比赛，想专注爵士舞，提升戏剧技巧。A 选项 “Let's go!” 为高级学生提供舞蹈和戏剧课程，专家教师指导，准备与最强对手竞争，符合需求。原文 “classes for advanced dance and drama students... work with you on your acting and preferred dance style... ready to compete against the best” 对应 “experienced dancer, jazz dance, drama skills, competitions”。
explanations.10: Jose 想在戏剧中表演，想参加专业人士开办的有文凭的表演课程。E 选项 “Peppermint Performers” 与经验丰富的戏剧导演合作，通过长期工作坊学习表演技能，第一学期有技能课程，成功学生获证书，符合需求。原文 “working with experienced theatre directors... long programme of workshops... certificates for successful students” 对应 “perform in plays, professional course, diploma”。
